findings.evidence: `RootGenerators.lean:129` (`typeBLongRootGenerator_lie_swap`) and `:299` (`typeBShortRootGenerator_lie_negative`) already state this family's bracket relations at general `ι`, so the file's natural level is index-generic. The general formulas follow from `TauCeti.lie_single_single` (`GeneralLinear/Basic.lean:157`, already imported): with `X_{ab} = E_{ab} - E_{-b,-a}`, `⁅X_{ab}, X_{cd}⁆ = δ_{bc}X_{ad} - δ_{ad}X_{cb}`, and with `e_i = 2E_{i0} - E_{0,-i}`, `⁅e_i, X_{kl}⁆ = -δ_{il} e_k`, `⁅f_i, X_{kl}⁆ = δ_{ik} f_l`; none of these depend on `ι = Fin (n+1)` or on consecutive indices.
findings.fix: Add general-`ι` bracket lemmas to `RootGenerators.lean` next to the existing general-`ι` relations, then specialize: `⁅typeBLongRootMatrix i j _, typeBLongRootMatrix k l _⁆ = 0` for `j ≠ k` and `i ≠ l`; `⁅typeBLongRootMatrix i j _, typeBLongRootMatrix j l _⁆ = typeBLongRootMatrix i l _`; `⁅typeBShortRootMatrix i, typeBLongRootMatrix k l _⁆ = -(if i = l then typeBShortRootMatrix k else 0)`; `⁅typeBShortNegativeRootMatrix i, typeBLongRootMatrix k l _⁆ = if i = k then typeBShortNegativeRootMatrix l else 0`. Each is a direct `lie_single_single` computation and each of the seven branches above becomes an instance.
findings.issue: The matrix-unit computations are done only for the Fin-indexed simple matrices, although the identities hold for `typeBLongRootMatrix`/`typeBShortRootMatrix` at arbitrary `ι` with arbitrary index pairs. The same computation is redone in seven places: lines 71-73, 77-80, 82-85 (mixed lemma, three branches), 103-105 (nonadjacent long-long), 113-123 (adjacent long-long, twice), 137-145 and 147-155 (short-long and long-short branches of `ad_pow_lie_typeBSimpleRootMatrix`).

findings.evidence: `lie_typeBSimpleRootMatrix_castSucc_of_nonadjacent` (line 97) has hypotheses `i.val + 1 ≠ j.val`, `j.val + 1 ≠ i.val`, both satisfied when `i = j`, giving `⁅Xᵢ, Xⱼ⁆ = 0` and hence the ad² statement in every non-adjacent case.
findings.fix: Drop `hij` and state the lemma for all `i j : Fin n`, discharging the extra cases with `lie_self` and `lie_typeBSimpleRootMatrix_castSucc_of_nonadjacent`; the adjacency split then lives only where the exponent is computed.
findings.issue: `lie_lie_typeBSimpleRootMatrix_castSucc_of_adjacent` assumes `i.val + 1 = j.val ∨ j.val + 1 = i.val`, but the conclusion `⁅Xᵢ, ⁅Xᵢ, Xⱼ⁆⁆ = 0` holds for all long nodes: for `i = j` by `lie_self`, and in the nonadjacent case the inner bracket is already `0`.

summary: The statements sit at the right level (arbitrary CommRing, Bourbaki-indexed simple system, exponents matching IsSerreSystem with the transposed Cartan matrix), but the underlying bracket identities are index-generic and are instead re-proved seven times as Fin-indexed special cases; one auxiliary lemma also carries an adjacency hypothesis it does not need.
